title: Web console has no CI job (lint, build, or e2e)
description:
Noticed while implementing auritus-69abb3. \`.github/workflows/ci.yml\` has
steps for \`cli\`, \`embed\`, \`site\`, and \`cdk\`, but nothing at all for
\`console/\` -- no npm ci, no lint, no build, no Playwright. Console's new
\`test:e2e\` script (added in auritus-69abb3, following \`site/\`'s naming
convention) and its Playwright suite currently only run if someone remembers
to run them locally.

Add a Console section to ci.yml mirroring the existing Site section: npm ci,
lint, build, and \`npx playwright install --with-deps chromium && npm run
test:e2e\`. The console needs a mock or a stubbed API endpoint to run
meaningfully in CI without live AWS credentials -- check how \`site/\`'s
Playwright suite handles that (or whether it does) before assuming the same
approach works for an authenticated app.
